# AstryxStatusDot { #anylumino.AstryxStatusDot }

```python
AstryxStatusDot(label, *, variant='neutral', **props)
```

Render an inline Astryx status indicator.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default     |
|---------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| label   | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                         | _required_  |
| variant | str    | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `'neutral'` |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe StatusDot props. Useful keys: isPulsing, tooltip, className, and style. The variant prop supports success, warning, error, accent, and neutral. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/StatusDot>. | `{}`        |
